reason: I'd self-host the Apache-2.0 version on my spare Mac mini and try it, but I won't pay $99 a month for a pre-alpha cloud run by one person. I don't need someone else's server when I already run my own.
objection: One developer, pre-alpha, side project. If they stop, my nightly pipeline and schedules stop with it, and I don't want a cloud I don't control holding anything near my code.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of steady releases and other teams running it, plus a self-hosted Host that does schedules and phone push without the paid cloud. Then I might pay for support.
